dct_title_s: South America, east and south coasts, Estrecho de Magallanes to Cabo de Hornos (Raster Image)
dct_description_sm: Prepared and published by the Defense Mapping Agency Hydrographic/Topographic Center. Depths shown by soundings and isolines. Relief shown by spot heights. "From Argentine and Chilean charts to 1978." "Copyright 1994 by the United States Government. No copyright claimed under Title 17 U.S.C." Includes index to next larger scale charts and compilation diagram. "Soundings in meters." Map no.22036 English and Spanish.
This map is part of a collection of scanned and georeferenced nautical charts produced by the National Geospatial-Intelligence Agency (NGA).
